The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#727; borg-reborn-rs #1064, PR #1082, merged into track-p as bc215cf8). Two arms in the patches-x8 world (the arms are compared only inside that world): ctl (shipped, attack_kill_on_sight_floor_cure 1) and cure0 (borg_param_attack_kill_on_sight_floor_cure 0, track-p's play before #1082). Runs, as requested: the patches-x8 pilot as the gate (about 6 times the patches of the normal world, #665's world check); if it plays differently, the patches-x8 verysmall; the normal world: a pilot as the gate and then the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm), before any shipped value is settled (the floor is rare there; the patch was 11 of 28 deaths on track-p 9085c266, before #969). The requester's local direction: the seven same-game deaths of the study play identical keys at flag 0 and 1 on this specimen, so the normal world may show no difference, which is a result too; the escape branch is reached in no replayed game.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, world patches-x8, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen bc215cf8. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; in a world every cell records it with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm; identical plays per arm. Report per arm and class: deaths and causes, rescued and newly killed against cure0 (exact McNemar; ctl is the control of the design, the question is ctl against cure0), CL and depth, alive at the cap having reached DL5; patch deaths (the patch as killer, or any killer while confused next to one); deaths with a cure potion in the pack; per game from messages.log (pilot evidence) how often each branch fires: '# Not attacking on sight: ... a cure or an escape at hand (#969)', '# Taking the cure the kill-on-sight floor counted: ... (#1064)', '# Kill-on-sight floor prefers the escape to its cure: ... (#1064)', '# Kill-on-sight floor: no escape usable, taking the cure after all: ... (#1064)', '# Kill-on-sight floor: stairs underfoot', '... Phase Door before the cure (#1064)', and Phase Door at site 'kill-on-sight floor'. Then the gate: ship the flag at 1 or 0, a borg-reborn-rs decision. Descriptive (RULES 14).
